conceptZh: 小玩具機器人領到一面比他還大的金牌，努力舉高、越舉越高，最後被自己的獎牌壓得整個往後翻倒，躺在地上還把金牌高高舉著不放；金牌接著攤開變成「金」字的屋頂、三條金條和兩顆小金珠。
object: a tiny toy robot and a gold medal bigger than he is
morph: the medal ribbon opens into the peaked top of 金, three gold bars stack into the 王 beneath it, and two small gold beads drop into the gaps on either side
creativeAngle: 接續運動與比賽的興趣，笑點是「獎牌比人大、舉到自己翻過去」的尺寸落差，倒地還死不放手的堅持特別好笑。金八畫結構單純，可以做完整組裝變形，和王那支的積木手法區隔在於這裡是獎牌自己攤開。語音詞「金牌」，金ㄐㄧㄣ、牌ㄆㄞˊ都是單一讀音，也避開和魚那支重複的金魚。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid warm ivory background. Centered stands a tiny boxy toy robot holding up a gold medal on a ribbon that is plainly bigger than he is. From 0.5 seconds he lifts it higher, and higher, arms trembling with pride, leaning further and further back to balance it. At 2.0 seconds he tips one degree too far and topples slowly backwards, landing flat on his back with a soft bonk - and keeps the medal held triumphantly at full stretch above him, refusing to let go. Hold that beat. At 3.0 seconds the ribbon unfolds into the wide peaked roof of the glyph, the medal itself flattens into three horizontal gold bars that stack neatly beneath it with one upright bar crossing them, and two small gold beads roll off the robot's shoulders and drop into the gaps on either side under the roof. The robot rolls out of frame to the left at 4.4 seconds, waving. By 4.8 seconds everything has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 金 in saturated deep amber brown, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins, its peaked top, three evenly spaced horizontal strokes, single vertical stroke and two separate dots all crisp and clearly readable. From 4.9 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 金 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「金、金、金牌」, using the reading ㄐㄧㄣ for 金 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 金 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 金牌 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 金: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 金色積木小隊頂著太大的尖頂，神氣疊高卻被壓成矮矮一團，最後分工排成清楚的「金」。
object: An original squad of expressive gold-colored interlocking building bricks, shaped to assemble the eight strokes of 金.
morph: The oversized paired roof strokes squash the squad's narrow tower. The bricks recover and deliberately arrange three horizontal strokes, one central vertical stroke, two distinct inward-slanting lower marks, and the two upper diagonal strokes into 金.
creativeAngle: 把積木小隊愛逞強的個性變成笑點：巨大的尖頂像帽子一路滑下，把高塔壓成矮胖一團，只剩兩塊小積木從兩側探頭。接著靠小隊自己走位、搭建完成字形，取代獎牌攤開變字的舊手法。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D animation in one locked, straight-on shot against a light warm-ivory background. The lead is an original squad of glossy gold-colored interlocking building bricks: proudly synchronized, hilariously overconfident, and quick to help one another. Tiny animated faces and retractable feet give them personality. Their elongated and wedge-shaped bodies are designed to assemble the exact eight-stroke Traditional Chinese glyph 金. Use no supporting characters or props.

At 0.0–1.2 seconds, the squad marches into a narrow central tower, each brick lifting its chin with exaggerated pride. Two long diagonal bricks join above them as a comically oversized peaked hat. At 1.2–1.8 seconds, the tower stretches upward to show off; its lowest brick trembles, while everyone above holds a solemn, triumphant expression. At 1.8–2.7 seconds, the heavy peaked hat slides straight down over the stack with three soft toy clacks, telescoping the tower into a squat little bundle. Two small wedge bricks tumble sideways and peek out from opposite edges of the enormous hat. Pause briefly on their synchronized, wide-eyed double take. Keep the action gentle and clearly visible.

At 2.7–4.6 seconds, the squad exchanges determined glances and rebuilds through visible walking, turning, and stacking. Three long bricks spread into horizontal strokes, with the bottom horizontal the widest; the upright brick positions itself centrally through them. The two small wedges take their separate lower-left and lower-right positions between the middle horizontal and the bottom horizontal, angled inward in the standard glyph. The paired diagonal bricks rise into the broad peaked 人-shaped top. Match a standard Traditional Chinese typeface precisely: preserve all eight strokes, their intersections, proportions, and open spaces. This is playful construction, not a depiction of historical etymology.

By 4.6 seconds, feet retract, faces disappear, and joints close flush to leave one clean, correctly formed 金. Hold this finished glyph completely still through 8.0 seconds, centered and uncropped at approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Its strokes have a uniform saturated deep golden-ochre face, with restrained metallic shading confined to shallow side edges; avoid glare that breaks stroke readability. Use soft studio lighting and bright, non-neon colors. The final composition contains only the single glyph and the plain background, with no other writing, subtitles, logos, watermarks, clutter, or flashing effects.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「金、金、黃金」. Pronounce 金 as ㄐㄧㄣ. Speak the first 金 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 1.3 seconds after a short pause, and 黃金 around 5.3–6.3 seconds while the finished glyph remains clearly visible. Stop after the word. Keep the toy clacks soft and below the voice; use no music or additional speech. The vocabulary word is audio only.
